title: Location of Parking Spaces Along City Island Avenue
previewText: In districts not otherwise governed by the streetscape regulations of Section 112-073, no parking shall be permitted between the street line of City Island Avenue and the street wall of any building or its prolongation facing City Island Avenue. However, this provision shall not apply to waterfront zoning lots.
